fullAccessCard.title: Turn on Full access?
fullAccessCard.description: In Full access the assistant starts and pays for the steps of a job without asking you every time.

points.spend: It can spend your credits on research, generation and rendering. A job never starts when its estimate is higher than your balance.
points.limitAmount: It still asks you once when a job would cost more than your approval limit, now {amount} credits. You can change or turn off the limit in Settings.
points.limitOff: You turned the approval limit off, so it asks about cost only when your balance is too low. You can turn the limit back on in Settings.
points.limitUnknown: It still asks you once when a job would cost more than your approval limit, which you set in Settings.
points.skip: Write “don't ask for approval” in a message to skip that one question for that job.
points.revoke: You confirm this once. You can go back to Ask or Auto at any time, or withdraw your confirmation in Settings.

fullAccessCard.revisionChanged: The text above was updated. Read it again and confirm to continue.
fullAccessCard.failed: Your confirmation could not be saved. Try again.

notice.membersNotAllowed: Your workspace admin has not allowed Full access for members. The current mode continues.
notice.unavailable: Full access could not be checked right now. The current mode continues.

limitAsk.text: This job could cost more than your Full access approval limit of {amount} credits, so I am asking once. Write “don't ask for approval” next to your request to skip this question, or change the limit in Settings.

rule.ask: Ask mode: I ask before every paid job.
rule.auto: Auto mode: I ask once when a job is estimated at {threshold} credits or more. Your balance always stops a job it cannot pay for.
rule.fullAccess: Full access: I ask only above your approval limit. Your balance always stops a job it cannot pay for. Write “don't ask for approval” to skip that question for one job.
rule.fullAccessLimit: Full access: I ask once when a job would cost more than {limit} credits. Write “don't ask for approval” to skip that question for one job. Your balance always stops a job it cannot pay for.
rule.fullAccessNoLimit: Full access: you turned the approval limit off, so only your balance can stop a job.

spendReceipt.label: Spend breakdown
spendReceipt.labelHint: Where the credits of this turn went. This is not an invoice: invoices are issued only for payments (credit top-ups, plan purchases and renewals, and usage charged to your card) and are in Settings > Billing.
spendReceipt.totalRunning: Used {credits} credits so far in this turn
